target: next distinct recorded non-birth event date, not a verified physiological onset

evaluationOnlyAssumption.meaning: Explicit counterfactual for dates-only comparisons, never a source fact or app eligibility estimate. No normalized file is overwritten.

chronology: same-day logging assumed; earlier starts only; target never used for eligibility
deduplication: collapse byte-equivalent source rows after line-ending normalization; conflicting same-person/day/event-type rows fail
birthHandling: Birth=1 is not a start. Keep all Birth=0 starts; retain event dates and flags in audit-only sidecars. Never retrospectively exclude primary targets using these annotations.
gapHandling: keep every interval, without length-based splitting, clipping, imputation or target exclusions; continuous observation is unverified
followUp: stop at last recorded start; final target censored; no additional observation time inferred
folds: all methods share conditional production-reference offered and observed cases; report withholding and censored cases separately
primaryContrast: paired MAE difference in days: weighted median minus production median; negative favors weighted
secondaryReporting: median and nearest-rank p90 absolute error
historical spread width and observed coverage

uncertainty.emptyReplicates: exclude undefined ratios and report their count
uncertainty.samplingUnit: all participants in the selected split, with replacement; keep every sampled person's rows together

sourceStrata: old-only, new-only, mixed; descriptive secondary reports without tuning on strata
releaseDecision: none; research comparisons cannot approve clinical use or a production model change
